dialogs.createBody: Create a new collection to organize your assets. You can add assets to this collection later.
dialogs.editBody: Edit the collection details. You can change the name, description, and visibility of the collection.
dialogs.deleteBody: Are you sure you want to delete this collection? This action cannot be undone!
dialogs.publicHelp: Public collections are visible to everyone and they might be featured on the homepage.
dialogs.privateHelp: Private collections are only visible to you.
dialogs.unlistedHelp: Unlisted collections are only visible to people with the link.

autoSync.enableBody1: Enabling auto-sync will clear all current modules in this collection and replace them with modules from the selected locations.
autoSync.enableBody2: This will happen automatically whenever your assets are imported.
autoSync.modeOn: Collection syncs automatically with selected locations
autoSync.modeOff: Manually manage modules in this collection
autoSync.autoDescription: Select which locations to track. The collection will automatically sync with these locations whenever your assets are imported.
autoSync.manualDescription: Due to security reasons you can only synchronize the visibility of modules in containers or ships. You can't toggle the visibility of stations. We recommend you to use station containers to manage your modules. Only containers that contain abyssal modules are shown here.
